name: backdrop
title: Backdrop
description: Full-frame colour or gradient fill with a padded, rounded, shadowed content frame (the floating-card look). Frame holds a built-in placeholder.
useWhen: You need a scene background: a coloured surround with a padded, rounded, shadowed inner frame.
You want the floating-card look for a screen recording or UI scene.
avoidWhen: You want a raw full-bleed colour with no frame: set padding and radius to 0.
You are inside a transition that manages its own full-frame layout.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Color
variables.description: Background colour when the fill type is Color.

variables.label: Gradient
variables.description: CSS gradient when the fill type is Gradient.

variables.label: Padding
variables.description: Gap between frame and edge, as a percentage of the frame width.

variables.label: Radius
variables.description: Corner radius of the frame, as a percentage of the frame width.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: CSS box-shadow of the frame. Empty for none.

variables.label: Placeholder content
variables.description: Draw a placeholder window inside the frame. Turn off for an empty frame a host layers its own scene over.
